verdict.rationale: Antigravity supports passing multimedia attachments (images, video, audio, documents) to its agent alongside prompts, and PDFs can be referenced in a project's Documents sidebar, which could enable design-to-app workflows, but there is no explicit documentation or example of generating a working app specifically from a sketch/image/PDF design. missing for 10: dedicated design-to-code/sketch-to-app feature, worked example or demo of image/PDF-driven app generation, independent confirmation of this capability.
